q: Are you passionate about people, culture, and transformation? Do you thrive at the intersection of strategy, organisations, and human behaviour? We’re looking for a People & Change Professional who’s ready to help organisations navigate change and unlock the potential of their people.
Well, if the shoe fits, then this is the opportunity for you!

The (Assistant) Manager will join the People & Change team within Risk Consulting, with a core focus on managing and delivering HR and people transformation engagements, particularly technology-enabled transformation. The role combines HR expertise, consulting experience and practical transformation capability to help clients redesign and deliver changes to HR functions, processes, operating models, employee experience and ways of working, with technology as a key enabler.

While People & Change will be the primary area of focus, the individual will also contribute to broader Risk Consulting and Advisory engagements. The role is client-facing and requires strong engagement management, commercial awareness, relationship building and business development capability, alongside project and change management expertise.
Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience, preferably including at least 5 years in consulting/advisory, HR transformation, change management or related transformation roles.
Demonstrated experience leading or delivering HR, people or technology-enabled transformation programmes.
Strong practical project management and change management experience within transformation environments.
Experience across areas such as HR transformation, HR operating models, process redesign, digital HR, employee experience and/or HR technology.
Demonstrated experience managing client engagements or significant workstreams, including scope, timelines, resources, risks and senior stakeholder relationships.
Strong consulting capability, including structured problem solving, workshop facilitation, proposal development and business development.
Experience coaching or managing junior team members and contributing to team capability development.
Experience in the GCC / Middle East would be advantageous.
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Human Capital Management, Organisational Psychology, Business Administration with an HR specialisation, or a related discipline.
Relevant professional qualification or certification in project management and/or change management.
PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification.
Prosci, CCMP or equivalent change management certification.
CIPD, SHRM or equivalent HR professional qualification.
Formal training or certification in a major HR technology / HCM platform would be advantageous.
r: Manage and deliver HR and people transformation engagements from assessment and design through implementation, transition and adoption.
Advise clients on HR operating models, process redesign, digital HR, employee experience, HR technology opportunities and transformation roadmaps.
Assess the impact of technology and broader business transformation on people, processes, structures, roles and ways of working, translating these into practical transformation interventions.

Apply strong project management disciplines across transformation programmes, including planning, governance, stakeholder coordination, risk and issue management, dependency management and progress reporting.
Lead change management activities including change impact and readiness assessments, stakeholder engagement, communications, training, business readiness and adoption.
Build trusted relationships with senior HR, business and technology stakeholders; facilitate workshops to define priorities, shape solutions and drive decisions.
Manage engagement scope, resources, timelines, budgets, risks and quality, ensuring delivery in line with firm requirements and agreed commercial objectives.
Lead and coach engagement teams, providing clear direction, constructive feedback and development support.
Develop client and market relationships, identify opportunities arising from engagements, and contribute to proposals, presentations, thought leadership and follow-on work.

Contribute to broader Risk Consulting and Advisory engagements where relevant, applying transformation, project management, change management and consulting capabilities beyond the core People & Change portfolio.
Collaborate across Risk Consulting and other Advisory disciplines to develop integrated solutions and identify appropriate cross-functional opportunities.
Maintain awareness of developments in HR, technology and transformation and translate relevant market trends into client opportunities and new advisory solutions.

Director of Engineering The Luxury Collection Muscat Grand Blue City Oman Discover a Destination Like No Other - located 45 minutes from Muscat International Airport

Set against the dramatic coastline of Oman and inspired by the rich culture, heritage, and natural beauty of the region, The Luxury Collection Muscat Grand Blue City Oman represents a distinctive luxury destination where authentic experiences meet world-class hospitality. As part of The Luxury Collection, every property tells a unique story, connecting guests with the character and spirit of its destination through exceptional design, personalised service, and immersive experiences.

We are seeking an accomplished Director of Engineering to join our leadership team and play a pivotal role in shaping the success of this remarkable property. This is an opportunity to oversee a complex luxury operation while contributing to a destination that celebrates Oman's heritage and showcases Marriott International's commitment to excellence.

As Director of Engineering, you will provide strategic leadership across all engineering, maintenance, sustainability, safety, and infrastructure functions of the hotel. You will be responsible for ensuring the property's physical assets consistently support an exceptional guest experience while maintaining operational efficiency and financial discipline.

Working closely with the executive committee and ownership representatives, you will lead a high-performing engineering team, drive preventive maintenance programmes, oversee capital projects, and ensure compliance with Marriott International standards. Your expertise will directly influence guest satisfaction, operational reliability, and the long-term value of the asset.
Provide strategic direction for all engineering and maintenance operations across the hotel.
Ensure the continuous functionality, safety, and appearance of all guest-facing and back-of-house facilities.
Lead preventive maintenance programmes designed to optimise asset performance and minimise downtime.
Manage departmental budgets, capital expenditure projects, and cost-control initiatives while delivering value-driven outcomes.
Champion sustainability, energy conservation, and environmental stewardship initiatives aligned with Marriott's global commitments.
Develop, mentor, and inspire a skilled engineering team, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Ensure full compliance with local regulations, health and safety requirements, and Marriott International brand standards.
Build strong relationships with ownership groups, contractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to support operational and strategic objectives.
The successful candidate will be a confident and inspiring leader with extensive experience managing engineering operations within luxury hospitality environments.

You bring a proven track record of overseeing complex hotel infrastructure, capital projects, and maintenance programmes while balancing operational priorities with commercial objectives. Equally comfortable in strategic discussions and hands-on problem solving, you possess the ability to make informed decisions that enhance guest satisfaction and protect asset value.

Exceptional communication skills and the ability to build credibility with associates, senior leaders, and ownership stakeholders.
